description: Window [4→9]: specification through quality-release. Asserts 6 stages activated in order, build HARD disciplines present, RED/GREEN evidence, stop at quality-release with no growth phase marker.

turns.text: Activate cycle:spec-to-ship. I have a spec. Start at specification stage and run through to quality-release.
Continue: design-ux — translate the spec into UX flows and component designs.
Continue: architecture — API contract, system ADR, infrastructure selection.
Continue: ai-ml — design the AI/ML route if applicable; else confirm no AI component.
Continue: build — implement. This is the first turn where build evidence is allowed.
Continue: quality-release — run tests, pass reliability gate. This is the window stop. Do NOT proceed past the window stop.
